title: SDK adoption bellwether cases and triage rubric for enterprise client libraries
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Create a reproducible triage rubric and a small set of "bellwether" SDK/features to prioritize customer requests for language support, auth patterns, and streaming ergonomics. The goal is to reduce stove-piped ad-hoc requests, surface measurable signals for engineering investment, and provide clear guidance for Solutions/SEs during enterprise onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page rubric that scores requests across tech risk, customer revenue signal, implementation cost, and maintenance burden
A prioritized list of 4 bellwether SDK feature-sets (language + auth + streaming behavior) with acceptance tests
A documented escalation path and handoff checklist for engineering spikes
Telemetry dashboard showing request volume by language and enterprise SSO patterns integrated into Console backlog
decisions: Bellwether languages will be Python, TypeScript, Java, and Go based on usage telemetry and enterprise affinity
Auth patterns prioritized: token rotation + short-lived creds first; then native SSO adapters (SAML/OIDC broker) as a second phase
Streaming ergonomics minimum: resumable client-side streams, explicit backpressure hints, and a small ergonomic SDK helper for reconnection
Do not commit to full feature parity for every language initially — focus on common surface and clear extension points
tradeoffs: Fast delivery vs long-term maintenance: narrower bellwether set reduces initial burden but requires clear docs to set expectations
Native SSO adapters increase customer satisfaction but add security review and maintenance overhead
Providing rich streaming helpers reduces integration friction but can mask server-side constraints and complicate debugging
notes: Intake pattern came from 5 enterprise customers in last quarter requesting first-class clients for Java/C# and improved streaming reconnection semantics
Solutions Engineering highlighted repeated confusion around token rotation during delegated auth flows — high friction during POC
Telemetry from Console shows 62% of SDK calls originate from Python and TS clients; Java and Go show higher latent enterprise conversion
We should coordinate with SDK ownership in Engineering (ENG SDK guild) to avoid diverging adapters
